decisions.reason: The wallet requirement for holding prize tickets is already captured by a complete same-message MODIFY on this Requirement.
Requiring a wallet to hold prize tickets does not change the primary-mint price or allocation of mint proceeds.
The Transak mint flow still permits fiat minting without an existing wallet; the new requirement applies only to subsequent prize-ticket holding.
The FAQ Requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY explaining that a wallet is needed to hold prize tickets.
The source change concerns prize-ticket holding and does not alter the amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or wallet payout mode of referral commissions.
A wallet prerequisite for holding tickets does not change the Big Block draw parameters or the eligibility of active tickets once held.
A wallet prerequisite for holding tickets does not change the Small Block draw parameters or the eligibility of active tickets once held.
The source decision does not alter which NFT state, including active prize tickets, transfers to a secondary buyer.
The wallet prerequisite for holding prize tickets does not change which ticket counters, badges, or referral-code attributes appear in NFT metadata.
The prize-ticket wallet requirement does not change allocation of the no-referral commission to a random existing NFT holder.
The source change does not affect the amount, visibility, enforcement, or allocation of secondary-sale royalties.
Requiring a wallet to hold prize tickets does not change Chainlink VRF selection, on-chain execution, fairness, or verification.
